post.description: What is on near a place during a stay: festivals, concerts, matches, markets, shows, exhibitions and seasons. Give the place as a location's slug, such as hermanus, or as a point, and the first and last day of the stay. An experience is returned only when it is on during the stay, and each result carries its sessions during the stay: the days it is on, or the month when its days are not announced yet. An experience is bookable when it is confirmed, its booking is open and it has a link to book through: its booking link, or failing that its own page. The filters decide what is returned. Results come most premium first, by tier (luxury, premium, standard, everyday; none counts as standard), and the query text, what the traveller likes in plain words, only orders the results within a tier. An attribute, option, tag or season that does not exist is refused with invalid_input, and the message names the ones that do.

location.description: The place to search around, as a location's slug, such as hermanus. The search is around the location's centre. Give this or near, not both.

near.description: The point to search around, such as the centre of Hermanus (-34.4187, 19.2345), when the place is not a location. Give this or location, not both.

radiusKm.description: How far from the location's centre or the point to search, in kilometres. Left out, the default radius is used.

from.description: The first day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before the first day.

status.description: Only experiences with one of these statuses. All four are returned when it is left out.

bookable.description: True returns only experiences that can be booked now: confirmed, with booking open, and with a booking link or, failing that, their own page to book through.

attributes.description: Filters by attribute key, such as category, format, audience, setting, scale, tier or minimum_age. Every attribute given must match. A list matches any of its values, and { min, max } is a number range. A range with only a max, such as minimum_age: { max: 12 }, also matches experiences with no value recorded. A key that is not an attribute, or a value that is not one of its options, is refused, and the error lists what can be used. tier is how premium an experience is: luxury, premium, standard or everyday; tier: ["luxury", "premium"] keeps only the premium end.

min.description: The lowest value to match. A range with a min matches only experiences that have a value.

max.description: The highest value to match. A range with only a max also matches experiences with no value.

tags.description: Tag slugs and season slugs, such as jazz, whales or whale-season. An experience with any one of them matches. A slug that is no tag or season is refused, and the error names the closest ones.

query.description: What the traveller likes, in plain words. It only orders the results, best match first within each tier, and never adds or removes one. Results are always most premium first, by tier. Put anything that must hold in the filters.

offset.description: How many experiences to skip, for paging.

200.description: The experiences that are on near the place during the dates and pass every filter.

id.description: The experience's lasting ID. It stays the same across searches and changes.

slug.description: A lasting, readable name for it, unique in the feed.

summary.description: A sentence or two on what it is. Empty when the source gives none.

description.description: What the source says about it, at more length. Empty when there is none.

type.description: How its dates are known. single: once, in one stretch. run: several set dates. recurring: repeats by a rule, such as every Saturday.

status.description: expected: an annual event expected to come round again, with only a month or a year and no announcement yet; its dates are likely, not promised. announced: announced, though dates or details may change. confirmed: dates fixed and going ahead. postponed: not on its dates, new dates unknown.

booking.description: none: nothing to book, such as a market. not_yet: will be bookable; onSaleAt says when, if known. open: can be booked now. sold_out: nothing is left. closed: booking has ended.

slug.description: The location's slug, as search takes it, such as hermanus.

name.description: The location's name, such as Hermanus.

location.description: The place in the feed it belongs to.

name.description: The venue's name. Empty when not stated.

address.description: The venue's street address. Empty when not stated.

city.description: The town or city the venue is in. Empty when not stated.

position.description: The venue's own coordinates, when the source states them. When empty, distanceKm is measured from the location's centre.

distanceKm.description: How far it is from the search point, in kilometres: from the venue when its position is known, otherwise from its location's centre.

timezone.description: The timezone its times are in, such as Africa/Johannesburg.

openingHours.description: Opening hours in the source's words, for something open over a period. Empty when not stated.

min.description: The lowest price, in its currency.

max.description: The highest price, in its currency.

currency.description: The currency's code, such as ZAR.

price.description: The lowest and highest price. A min and max of 0 mean it is free; empty means the source states no price.

onSaleAt.description: When booking opens, as an ISO timestamp. Empty when not known.

bookingClosesAt.description: When booking closes, as an ISO timestamp. Empty when not known.

bookingUrl.description: Where to book it. Empty when the source gives no booking link.

imageUrl.description: An image of it, from its source. Empty when there is none.

pageUrl.description: A page about this experience alone, when its source gives one. Where to book is bookingUrl.

attributes.description: The experience's values by attribute key, such as its categories and its tier: luxury, premium, standard or everyday. One with no tier counts as standard.

tags.description: Its tag slugs, such as jazz or whales, and season slugs, such as whale-season. A season is given only when all of its dates fall inside the season.

startDate.description: The first day it is on, as YYYY-MM-DD. For month or year precision, the month's or year's first day.

endDate.description: The last day of this stretch, as YYYY-MM-DD: the start day for a single day. For month or year precision, the month's or year's last day.

precision.description: Month or year means the experience is on in that month or year and its days are not announced yet.

startTime.description: When it starts, as HH:MM in the experience's timezone. Empty when not stated.

endTime.description: When it ends, as HH:MM in the experience's timezone. Empty when not stated.

label.description: The source's name for this date, such as "Opening night". Empty when there is none.

soldOut.description: True when this date is sold out, though others may not be.

sessions.description: Its sessions during the stay asked for. It is on no other day of the stay.

version.description: Goes up by one with every real change to the experience.

updatedAt.description: When it last changed, as an ISO timestamp.

bookable.description: True when it can be booked now: confirmed, booking open, and a link to book through, its bookingUrl or, failing that, its pageUrl. Everything else is information only.

items.description: The experiences on this page, most premium first, by tier; within a tier, best match first when a query text is given, then by date.

total.description: How many experiences match, across all pages.

limit.description: The most this page holds, as asked for.

offset.description: How many were skipped before this page, as asked for.

schema.description: The experiences that are on near the place during the dates and pass every filter.

post.description: What changed since you last searched, among the experiences the same search selects: new, confirmed, rescheduled, postponed, cancelled, removed or otherwise changed. Give the same search, without its query text, and since: when you last searched. An empty answer means nothing changed. Cancelled and removed experiences are reported, though search no longer returns them; experiences that are over are not. An experience that was on during the stay when you searched, and is not now, is reported with movedOut true and the sessions it has now, outside the stay. Each result has the change that matters most to a planner and every change since, newest first. The most recent change comes first.

location.description: The place to search around, as a location's slug, such as hermanus. The search is around the location's centre. Give this or near, not both.

near.description: The point to search around, such as the centre of Hermanus (-34.4187, 19.2345), when the place is not a location. Give this or location, not both.

radiusKm.description: How far from the location's centre or the point to search, in kilometres. Left out, the default radius is used.

from.description: The first day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before the first day.

attributes.description: Filters by attribute key, such as category, format, audience, setting, scale, tier or minimum_age. Every attribute given must match. A list matches any of its values, and { min, max } is a number range. A range with only a max, such as minimum_age: { max: 12 }, also matches experiences with no value recorded. A key that is not an attribute, or a value that is not one of its options, is refused, and the error lists what can be used. tier is how premium an experience is: luxury, premium, standard or everyday; tier: ["luxury", "premium"] keeps only the premium end.

min.description: The lowest value to match. A range with a min matches only experiences that have a value.

max.description: The highest value to match. A range with only a max also matches experiences with no value.

tags.description: Tag slugs and season slugs, such as jazz, whales or whale-season. An experience with any one of them matches. A slug that is no tag or season is refused, and the error names the closest ones.

status.description: Only experiences with one of these statuses. Cancelled and removed experiences are reported whatever it says.

bookable.description: True reports only experiences that can be booked now, confirmed with booking open, and the cancelled and removed ones.

since.description: When you last searched, as an ISO timestamp such as 2027-02-01T09:30:00Z. Only later changes are reported.

limit.description: How many changed experiences to return.

offset.description: How many changed experiences to skip, for paging.

200.description: The experiences that changed since the time given, among those the search parameters select.

id.description: The experience's lasting ID. It stays the same across searches and changes.

slug.description: A lasting, readable name for it, unique in the feed.

summary.description: A sentence or two on what it is. Empty when the source gives none.

description.description: What the source says about it, at more length. Empty when there is none.

type.description: How its dates are known. single: once, in one stretch. run: several set dates. recurring: repeats by a rule, such as every Saturday.

status.description: expected, announced, confirmed or postponed, as in a search; or cancelled, called off by its organisers, or removed, listed by no source any more. Cancelled and removed are final.

booking.description: none: nothing to book, such as a market. not_yet: will be bookable; onSaleAt says when, if known. open: can be booked now. sold_out: nothing is left. closed: booking has ended.

slug.description: The location's slug, as search takes it, such as hermanus.

name.description: The location's name, such as Hermanus.

location.description: The place in the feed it belongs to.

name.description: The venue's name. Empty when not stated.

address.description: The venue's street address. Empty when not stated.

city.description: The town or city the venue is in. Empty when not stated.

position.description: The venue's own coordinates, when the source states them. When empty, distanceKm is measured from the location's centre.

distanceKm.description: How far it is from the search point, in kilometres: from the venue when its position is known, otherwise from its location's centre.

timezone.description: The timezone its times are in, such as Africa/Johannesburg.

openingHours.description: Opening hours in the source's words, for something open over a period. Empty when not stated.

min.description: The lowest price, in its currency.

max.description: The highest price, in its currency.

currency.description: The currency's code, such as ZAR.

price.description: The lowest and highest price. A min and max of 0 mean it is free; empty means the source states no price.

onSaleAt.description: When booking opens, as an ISO timestamp. Empty when not known.

bookingClosesAt.description: When booking closes, as an ISO timestamp. Empty when not known.

bookingUrl.description: Where to book it. Empty when the source gives no booking link.

imageUrl.description: An image of it, from its source. Empty when there is none.

pageUrl.description: A page about this experience alone, when its source gives one. Where to book is bookingUrl.

attributes.description: The experience's values by attribute key, such as its categories and its tier: luxury, premium, standard or everyday. One with no tier counts as standard.

tags.description: Its tag slugs, such as jazz or whales, and season slugs, such as whale-season. A season is given only when all of its dates fall inside the season.

startDate.description: The first day it is on, as YYYY-MM-DD. For month or year precision, the month's or year's first day.

endDate.description: The last day of this stretch, as YYYY-MM-DD: the start day for a single day. For month or year precision, the month's or year's last day.

precision.description: Month or year means the experience is on in that month or year and its days are not announced yet.

startTime.description: When it starts, as HH:MM in the experience's timezone. Empty when not stated.

endTime.description: When it ends, as HH:MM in the experience's timezone. Empty when not stated.

label.description: The source's name for this date, such as "Opening night". Empty when there is none.

soldOut.description: True when this date is sold out, though others may not be.

sessions.description: Its sessions during the stay asked for. When movedOut is true it has none there, and these are the sessions it has now, all outside the stay: where it moved to. Empty when it has no dates left.

version.description: Goes up by one with every real change to the experience.

updatedAt.description: When it last changed, as an ISO timestamp.

bookable.description: True when it can be booked now: confirmed, booking open, and a link to book through, its bookingUrl or, failing that, its pageUrl. Everything else is information only.

experience.description: The experience as it is now, as a search returns it.

movedOut.description: True when the experience was on during the stay asked for before a change since then, and is not on during it now: it moved out of the stay, or its sessions in it were dropped or cancelled. Treat it as no longer on during the stay.

kind.description: new: first published. confirmed: its dates are now fixed. rescheduled: a date was added, moved or removed. postponed: not happening on its dates, new dates unknown. cancelled: called off by its organisers. removed: no source lists it any more. changed: anything else, booking and price included.

change.description: The change that matters most to a planner.

kind.description: new: first published. confirmed: its dates are now fixed. rescheduled: a date was added, moved or removed. postponed: not happening on its dates, new dates unknown. cancelled: called off by its organisers. removed: no source lists it any more. changed: anything else, booking and price included.

changes.description: Every change since the time given, newest first.

items.description: The experiences that changed, the most recent change first.

total.description: How many experiences changed, across all pages.

limit.description: The most this page holds, as asked for.

offset.description: How many were skipped before this page, as asked for.

schema.description: The experiences that changed since the time given, among those the search parameters select.
